01 / THE IDEA

A WORKFLOW, NOT A BLACK BOX

From task to reviewed change.

The planned experience, one step at a time.
Select a step to explore the design.

REPOSITORY / LOCAL FIRST

Start where your code lives.

The first milestone is opening a local Git repository in a dedicated task workspace. Cloud environments will come later, after the local workflow is dependable.

Planned: repository selection and an isolated branch for each task.
DESIGNED AROUND DEVELOPERS

Control is part of the workflow.

[ / ]

Local comes first.

Start with the tools and repositories on your machine. Build a reliable local loop before introducing remote execution.

>_

Make the work visible.

The design puts task activity, command output, and proposed changes in one place, so you can see what happened.

{ ± }

Review before shipping.

Agents propose changes. Developers inspect the diff and decide what to keep. Explicit approval is a core design goal.

BUILDING IN THE OPEN

Small steps. A clear direction.

This is an early-stage project.
No agent runtime has shipped yet.

PHASE 01 NOW

Lay the foundation

Define the workflow, document the architecture, and prepare the project for contributors.

  • Project website and initial documentation
  • Local-first MVP specification
  • Public repository and contribution guide
PHASE 02 PLANNED

Build the local loop

Complete one task from repository selection to a reviewable diff.

  • One coding-agent integration
  • Task activity and test output
  • Changes awaiting human review
PHASE 03 EXPLORING

Extend to the cloud

Carry the same task and review model into isolated remote environments.

  • Remote execution environments
  • Environment and secret boundaries
  • Portable task history
